title: No-fee OA publishing in Africa CoP
what_changed: The Community of Practice for no-fee (Diamond) OA publishing in Africa held its next meeting on 18 November (10:00 UTC), reviewing 2026 results, planning next year, and collecting editors' and publishers' needs and challenges; the meeting was moderated by EIFL's Milica Sevkusic and is part of the Wellcome-funded "Collaboration for Sustainable Open Access Publishing in Africa".
why_it_matters: The CoP is the standing community infrastructure for Diamond OA in the region, and the monitor explicitly tracks Global South publishing capacity; agenda-setting meetings like this decide its next-year priorities.
